title: Voice messages and audio
summary: Timeline row for voice messages and audio files: play and pause, a waveform you can drag, speed, and the sender's transcript under the player (ADR 0023). The transcript is the caption of the voice event.

isVoice.description: true when the audio has the voice flag (UnstableVoiceContent). false: an audio file, shown with its name.

waveform.description: From UnstableAudioDetailsContent. Empty: a flat line.

transcript.description: The caption of a voice message: the sender's transcript.

playback.description: loading: Client.getMediaFile downloads and decrypts the Ogg Opus file.

speed.description: Tap cycles 1x, 1,5x, 2x. Kept for the app, not per message.

play.effect: Downloads once, then plays. Only one audio plays at a time; when it ends, the next voice message right after it plays too.

positionMs.description: The new position from a drag on the waveform.

notes: Transcript display (ADR 0023): on a voice message a caption is a transcript. The reader's phone never transcribes. A voice message without a caption shows no transcript row.
The scam check reads the transcript of incoming voice messages (message-scam-warning, security.md rule 9).
bipe_app_media_voice_label is the accessibility label: %1$s the length formatted by the system. bipe_app_media_speed takes the speed text (1x, 1,5x, 2x).
Playback goes on with the screen locked and shows lock-screen controls (audio.md phase 1).
Bipe logic: BipeVoiceTranscriptView (Android libraries/bipe ui). The iOS transcript row is fork UI, not BipeKit; write it from this spec.
